annotations.title: Can you run it at home?

description: Kingy's verdict on running a model on your own hardware: Yes, Yes but slow, Barely, No or Not tested yet, per machine type (8GB GPU PC or laptop, 16GB laptop, 24GB Mac, 24GB or 32GB GPU PC, 64GB Mac, 128GB Mac or Strix Halo, 512GB Mac Studio). Each verdict names the exact file and format, the runtime, the speed, and whether Kingy measured it, a third party reported it, or it is estimated.
